title: I miss Rich
summary: A sentimental tribute to Rich Piana. Despite Rich being his opposite (heavily enhanced, implants), NH admires his honesty, humour, and refusal to censor, crediting him with forcing the industry to be open about drug use. He criticises the copycat 'daddy' influencers and mass monsters who imitate Rich's exterior without his genuineness.
claims: Rich Piana was the biggest bodybuilding page of his time, mixing serious direct advice with light-hearted humour in a way never replicated
Rich was one of the first top bodybuilders to openly say pros are big from drugs and supplements are bunk; today's openness about drug use is owed to him
Rich sold supplements while telling people they didn't need them and should eat real food
NH bought Rich's supplements in college despite finding them disgusting, purely because he liked the man
Rich openly said he'd likely die young, was aware of his severe bigorexia, and was married to size; his death from a drug cocktail was unsurprising
When a bodybuilder dies, it's because of the drugs
Rich created the 'dad' influencer genre; today's copycats imitate his persona as a role, not as who they are
Rich never censored his comment section, while today's influencers ban critics to protect an image
Today's mass monsters copy Rich's exterior and size without his charisma; size isn't why he is remembered
What matters is not whether someone takes drugs but whether they are genuine about it
